treatment_summary: The plan addresses the three core components of metabolic syndrome. Initiate ramipril as the preferred ACE‑I for hypertension, titrating to target dose while monitoring potassium and renal function. Start atorvastatin 20 mg nightly for primary CVD prevention, with lipid monitoring at 3 months. Begin metformin MR after confirming eGFR ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m² to improve insulin sensitivity and prevent diabetes progression. Continue existing amlodipine, inhaled corticosteroid, and SABA for asthma. Provide lifestyle counselling (weight loss, Mediterranean diet, 150 min/week exercise) and arrange necessary baseline labs and QRISK calculation. All choices are supported by NICE CG181, NG136, and NG28.
